POSE 1 (Top Left): OK. Balanced stance, limbs in natural positions.
POSE 2 (Top Middle): ISSUE. Spine excessively curved, knees hyperextended, balance precarious.
POSE 3 (Top Right): OK. Dynamic mid-air pose, limbs positioned for clearance.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): OK. Relaxed standing pose, weight distributed evenly.
POSE 5 (Bottom Middle): ISSUE. Knees crossed awkwardly, unstable base of support.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): ISSUE. Feet crossed at ankles, poor balance and unnatural leg alignment.
